title: Recover a queue ejection before release enrollment
trigger: A queued PR is unmergeable in its train while it remains mergeable against the base, or an item has an open correction landing.
need: Read the snapshotted preceding PRs and shared files. Wait until those entries land or leave, then re-read base mergeability: rebase and re-verify a conflicting head; re-enqueue an unchanged mergeable head through the observer. The server record drives merge --wait and names read failures with recovery. Release admission and containment refuse a current run member's open correction PR until it lands or closes; a member removed from the run never blocks it. A failed train refuses unchanged head/base inputs. Fix the cause on the lane, commit and re-verify. For an unrelated cause, file feedback, promote the fix item, record a dependency and park while the gate stays red. A missing web URL is derived from the identified Actions run id and repository. Automatic conflict re-entry requests Contents: write as well as Pull requests: write. An explicit hold suppresses stopped notices across pushes until fresh arming or queue entry. A failed-disarm notice names yoke github merge-queue hold <item>; run it before pushing a fix and re-entering merge item.
